class.name: AIController
class.brief_description: A controller with nobody behind it.
class.description: It exists only where the rules are decided - on the server - so a pawn it possesses is driven there and mirrored to everyone else like any other pawn. It has no [LocalPlayer] and no [InputComponent]: nothing about it reads input. Add one to a level and call [method possess_pawn_root] with the node the pawn scene is rooted at, or [method Controller.possess] with the [Pawn] itself.
